localities_coordinates_check.name: localities_coordinates_check
localities_coordinates_check.value: ("localities"."latitude" IS NULL) = ("localities"."longitude" IS NULL) AND ("localities"."latitude" IS NULL OR ("localities"."latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "localities"."longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180))

businesses_zone_check.name: businesses_zone_check
businesses_zone_check.value: "businesses"."zone_id" IS NOT NULL OR "businesses"."zone_other" IS NOT NULL

businesses_pin_check.name: businesses_pin_check
businesses_pin_check.value: ("businesses"."latitude" IS NULL) = ("businesses"."longitude" IS NULL) AND ("businesses"."latitude" IS NULL OR ("businesses"."latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "businesses"."longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180))

businesses_rejection_check.name: businesses_rejection_check
businesses_rejection_check.value: ("businesses"."rejected_at" IS NULL) = ("businesses"."rejection_reason" IS NULL) AND ("businesses"."rejected_at" IS NULL OR "businesses"."status" = 'rejected')

pending_edits_zone_check.name: pending_edits_zone_check
pending_edits_zone_check.value: "pending_edits"."zone_id" IS NOT NULL OR "pending_edits"."zone_other" IS NOT NULL

pending_edits_new_photo_check.name: pending_edits_new_photo_check
pending_edits_new_photo_check.value: ("pending_edits"."new_photo_key" IS NULL OR "pending_edits"."photo_change" = 'replace') AND ("pending_edits"."status" <> 'pending' OR "pending_edits"."photo_change" <> 'replace' OR "pending_edits"."new_photo_key" IS NOT NULL) AND "pending_edits"."new_photo_key" ~ '^(dev_)?[23456789abcdefghjkmnpqrstuvwxyz]{24}$'

pending_edits_resolution_check.name: pending_edits_resolution_check
pending_edits_resolution_check.value: ("pending_edits"."status" = 'pending') = ("pending_edits"."resolved_at" IS NULL) AND ("pending_edits"."discard_reason" IS NULL OR "pending_edits"."status" = 'discarded')
